title: 第7章 炼气境七重如蝼蚁谁人能挡第8章 你想怎么死
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: 轰地一声，李轩带着滔天杀意冲入，一巴掌就狠狠甩在了赵常青脸上。
赵常青一声惨叫，直接被抽飞出去。
李轩根本就不等他落地，手中凡剑闪电般斩出。
嗤嗤嗤嗤！
一道道剑光划过，赵常青身上冒起一簇簇血花，嘴里发出了凄厉惨叫。
当他倒在地上之时，手筋脚筋就已经全部被挑断，身上还多出无数道剑痕，浑身痉挛，不受控制的抽搐了起来。
他看着李轩，惊恐的瞪大了眼睛，眼中满是难以置信和恐惧。
这家伙不是跑路了吗？
他怎么会在这里？
“是我。”
李轩看着赵常青，脸色冷的可怕。
此时的丫丫和云老早已经昏迷过去。
不是被吓的，而是李轩做的，他不想让这爷孙两人看到这种血腥场面。
赵常青肝胆欲裂，你了半天，都没能说出一句完整的话来。
李轩右手一扬，把其余那些赵家人性命全部收走，这才冷冰冰道：
“赵家，很好，本来我还没想过去你赵家，现在看来倒是我太仁慈了。”
赵常青听到这话，惊骇欲绝，颤声道：“你，你要做什么？”
李轩却是根本没理他，他先是查看了一下云老伯爷孙情况，为两人简单疗伤了一下。
这才处理了那些尸体和血迹，然后如同垃圾般拎起赵常青，迈步离去。
当李轩拎着犹如死狗般的赵常青出现在大街上之时，整个平阳镇都轰动了。
“快看，李轩出现了！”
“那，那被他拎在手里的不是赵常青吗，怎么那么惨？”
“嘿，坏事做多了呗，这是老天开眼，遭报应了。”
“快，快去赵家，要有大事发生了。”
一道道声音传遍大街小巷，没多久的时间，几乎大半的小镇居民便都冲了出来。
只不过那些人都没敢太过靠近李轩，只是远远跟着。
赵常青看着那些人，简直死的心都有了。
他何时被人如此羞辱过？
他很想晕厥过去，甚至恨不得现在就死，但无奈的是，他根本就做不到。
content_en:
With a bang, Li Xuan rushed in with overwhelming murderous intent, and slapped Zhao Changqing hard on the face.
"Ah!"
Zhao Changqing screamed and was whipped out.
Li Xuan didn't even wait for him to land, and slashed out the sword in his hand like lightning.
Tsk tsk tsk!
A series of sword lights passed by, and clusters of blood appeared on Zhao Changqing's body, and he let out a shrill scream.
When he fell to the ground, his hand tendons and hamstrings had all been severed, and there were countless sword marks on his body. His whole body was convulsing and twitching uncontrollably.
"Li, Li Xuan..."
He looked at Li Xuan, his eyes widened in horror, full of disbelief and fear.
Didn't this guy run away?
Why is he here?
"It's me."
Li Xuan looked at Zhao Changqing with a terrifyingly cold expression.
At this time, Yaya and Yun Lao had already passed out.
It was not because he was frightened, but because Li Xuan did it. He didn't want the grandfather and grandson to see such a bloody scene.
"You, you..."
Zhao Changqing's liver and gallbladder were splitting, and you couldn't even utter a complete sentence after waiting for a long time.
Li Xuan raised his right hand and took away all the lives of the rest of the Zhao family, and then said coldly:
"The Zhao family is very good. I didn't want to go to your Zhao family at first, but now it seems that I am too kind."
When Zhao Changqing heard this, he was horrified and said in a trembling voice: "You, what are you going to do?"
Li Xuan ignored him at all. He first checked on Uncle Yun's grandfather and grandson, and briefly healed them.
Only then did he deal with the corpses and blood stains, then picked up Zhao Changqing like garbage and walked away.
When Li Xuan appeared on the street carrying Zhao Changqing, who was like a dead dog, the whole Pingyang Town was shocked.
"Look, Li Xuan has appeared!"
"Then, isn't it Zhao Changqing who is being held in his hands? Why is it so miserable?"
"Hey, you have done too many bad things. God is opening your eyes and you are getting retribution."
"Hurry, go to Zhao's house, something big is going to happen."
Sounds spread through the streets and alleys, and within a short time, almost half of the town residents rushed out.
But those people didn't dare to get too close to Li Xuan, they just followed him from a distance.
Zhao Changqing looked at those people and almost felt like dying.
When had he been so humiliated?
He wanted to faint, and even wished he could die right now, but unfortunately, he couldn't do it.
title_en: Chapter 7: Who can stop the seventh level of Qi Refining Realm, like an ant? Chapter 8: How do you want to die?
